messages:
toni: Embeds service showing brief 5xx spike at 00:05 UTC. Likely migration sidecar deadlock. Need hotpatch to restart worker + flip MIGRATION_FLAG. Request expedited approval (SRE+Product).

deploybot: Intake acknowledged. Hotpatch template: image=redwood/embeds:hotfix-mig-2026, canary=10% for 3m, approvals required: @hwa (SRE) + @mina (Product). Provide rollback plan and runbook.

hwa: Oncall SRE. I need a rollback one-liner and abort thresholds.

toni: Runbook summary: 1) Kick canary 10% for 3m. 2) Abort if errors >1% or p95 increases >150ms. 3) Rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeds`. 4) Notify customers after full rollout.

mina: Product OK, no schema changes. Release note: "Hotfix: restart worker and toggle migration flag to resolve intermittent 5xxs. No API changes."

hwa: Staging smoke passed. Approving after canary green.

deploybot: Manual gate created. To approve: `/deploy approve 6300000000 --by @hwa` and `/deploy approve 6300000000 --by @mina`. Canary kicked at 00:12 UTC (cb-6300000000). Initial canary metrics: errors=0.2%, p95 +25ms.

hwa: Canary green, `/deploy approve 6300000000 --by @hwa`

mina: Approved from Product, `/deploy approve 6300000000 --by @mina`

deploybot: Both approvals received. Promoting to 100% at 00:16 UTC. Rollout finished 00:18 UTC. Post-rollout: errors 0.15%, p95 nominal. No rollback executed.

opsbot: Monitoring window +15m active. No regressions observed.

toni: Thanks everyone. Posting release note and closing thread after monitor period. :white_check_mark:
